summary: Current-state documentation claimed 11.2.22 while authoritative code/version sources are 11.2.24.
impact: Users could reload the wrong extension version or mistake historical evidence for current main.

problem: POST/PUT /api/overlay/settings lacked _require_overlay_settings_access(request), allowing unauthenticated chess-site writes and normal-mode lease release.
fix: Called _require_overlay_settings_access(request) as the first executable statement; added HTTPBoundaryTests regression for unauthenticated POST and PUT.
validation: Pre-fix regression failed with 200 != 403 for both methods; post-fix regression and three related HTTP contract tests passed (4/4); py_compile and compileall passed. Full locked suite, Windows/Edge gates, and CI readback remain pending or blocked.

problem: An unavailable or unverified native private overlay was displayed as ready and capture-excluded while idle.
root_cause: The no-stream branch discarded the backend overlay status and synthesized available:true plus capture_excluded from the requested mode.
fix: Preserved the backend status returned by syncOverlaySettings(), while defaulting available and capture_excluded to false unless explicitly verified true; kept the waiting_for_capture state.
regression_test: tests/test_viewer_reliability.js::idle private viewer preserves unavailable native status
validation: RED before fix: existing tests/test_viewer_browser.py:145-160 and the added idle-private regression observed the unavailable backend rendering Bereit instead of Nicht verfuegbar. GREEN after fix: node --test tests/test_viewer_reliability.js passed 15/15; viewer inline-script syntax validation passed. Full locked suite, Windows/Edge gates, and CI readback remain pending or blocked.
